ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: In the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $\angle ACB=90^\circ$, point D is the midpoint of side AB, and CD is connected. If $BC=4$ and $CD=3$, what is the value of $\sin\angle DCB$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that in $\triangle ABC$, $\angle ACB=90^\circ$, and point D is the midpoint of side AB,\\
$\therefore$AD=BD=CD=$\frac{1}{2}$AB,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle DCB=\angle B$,\\
Also, since CD=3,\\
$\therefore$AB=6,\\
$AC=\sqrt{AB^{2}-BC^{2}}=\sqrt{6^{2}-4^{2}}=2\sqrt{5}$,\\
$\therefore$ $\sin\angle DCB=\sin B=\frac{AC}{AB}=\frac{2\sqrt{5}}{6}=\boxed{\frac{\sqrt{5}}{3}}$.
